evidence: Matches 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies secondary indexes across src/index/ and src/node/indexes.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Removes process-global ownership of secondary indexes (`g_txindex`, `g_txospenderindex`, `g_coin_stats_index`, and `g_filter_indexes`) and moves unique ownership into `NodeContext`. This decouples the index library from node internals and eliminates global state to benefit node encapsulation and multi-instance testing.
